reference_sql:
SELECT t.category, t.tactic,
       COUNT(*) AS product_store_weeks,
       AVG(t.units) AS avg_units,
       b.no_promo_avg_units,
       ROUND(100.0 * (AVG(t.units) - b.no_promo_avg_units) / NULLIF(b.no_promo_avg_units, 0), 1) AS units_diff_pct
FROM (
  -- one row per product, store and week, with its category and its tactic
  SELECT p.category, s.units,
         CASE WHEN s.feature = 1 AND s.display = 1 THEN 'feature and display'
              WHEN s.feature = 1 THEN 'feature only'
              WHEN s.display = 1 THEN 'display only'
              WHEN s.tpr_only = 1 THEN 'price reduction only'
              ELSE 'no promotion' END AS tactic
  FROM transactions AS s
  JOIN products AS p ON p.upc = s.upc
) AS t
LEFT JOIN (
  -- one row per category, with its average units in weeks of no promotion
  SELECT p.category, AVG(s.units) AS no_promo_avg_units
  FROM transactions AS s
  JOIN products AS p ON p.upc = s.upc
  WHERE s.feature = 0 AND s.display = 0 AND s.tpr_only = 0
  GROUP BY p.category
) AS b ON b.category = t.category
WHERE t.tactic <> 'no promotion'
GROUP BY t.category, t.tactic, b.no_promo_avg_units
ORDER BY t.category, t.tactic

WITH classed AS (
  -- one row per product, store and week, with its category and its tactic
  SELECT p.category, s.units,
         CASE WHEN s.feature = 1 AND s.display = 1 THEN 'feature and display'
              WHEN s.feature = 1 THEN 'feature only'
              WHEN s.display = 1 THEN 'display only'
              WHEN s.tpr_only = 1 THEN 'price reduction only'
              ELSE 'no promotion' END AS tactic
  FROM transactions AS s
  JOIN products AS p ON p.upc = s.upc
),
by_tactic AS (
  -- one row per category and tactic, with its rows and its average units
  SELECT category, tactic, COUNT(*) AS product_store_weeks, AVG(units) AS avg_units
  FROM classed
  GROUP BY category, tactic
)
SELECT t.category, t.tactic, t.product_store_weeks, t.avg_units,
       b.avg_units AS no_promo_avg_units,
       ROUND(100.0 * (t.avg_units - b.avg_units) / NULLIF(b.avg_units, 0), 1) AS units_diff_pct
FROM by_tactic AS t
LEFT JOIN by_tactic AS b ON b.category = t.category AND b.tactic = 'no promotion'
WHERE t.tactic <> 'no promotion'
ORDER BY t.category, t.tactic

SELECT r.category, r.tactic, r.product_store_weeks, r.avg_units, r.no_promo_avg_units,
       ROUND(100.0 * (r.avg_units - r.no_promo_avg_units) / NULLIF(r.no_promo_avg_units, 0), 1) AS units_diff_pct
FROM (
  -- one row per category and tactic, with its rows, its average units and its category's average with no promotion
  SELECT t.category, t.tactic, COUNT(*) AS product_store_weeks, AVG(t.units) AS avg_units,
         (SELECT AVG(s2.units)
          FROM transactions AS s2
          JOIN products AS p2 ON p2.upc = s2.upc
          WHERE p2.category = t.category
            AND s2.feature = 0 AND s2.display = 0 AND s2.tpr_only = 0) AS no_promo_avg_units
  FROM (
    -- one row per promoted product, store and week, with its category and its tactic
    SELECT p.category, s.units,
           CASE WHEN s.feature = 1 AND s.display = 1 THEN 'feature and display'
                WHEN s.feature = 1 THEN 'feature only'
                WHEN s.display = 1 THEN 'display only'
                ELSE 'price reduction only' END AS tactic
    FROM transactions AS s
    JOIN products AS p ON p.upc = s.upc
    WHERE s.feature = 1 OR s.display = 1 OR s.tpr_only = 1
  ) AS t
  GROUP BY t.category, t.tactic
) AS r
ORDER BY r.category, r.tactic

solver.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT p.category,
    CASE WHEN x.feature = 1 AND x.display = 1 THEN 'feature and display'
         WHEN x.feature = 1 AND x.display = 0 THEN 'feature only'
         WHEN x.display = 1 AND x.feature = 0 THEN 'display only'
         WHEN x.tpr_only = 1 AND x.feature = 0 AND x.display = 0 THEN 'price reduction only'
         WHEN x.feature = 0 AND x.display = 0 AND x.tpr_only = 0 THEN 'none' END AS tactic,
    x.units
  FROM transactions x JOIN products p ON p.upc = x.upc
  WHERE x.week_end_date >= DATE '2009-01-14' AND x.week_end_date <= DATE '2012-01-04'
), g AS (
  SELECT category, tactic, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(units) AS a FROM t GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT g.category, g.tactic, g.n AS product_store_weeks, g.a AS avg_units, b.a AS no_promo_avg_units,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN b.a IS NULL OR b.a = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 100 * (g.a - b.a) / b.a END, 1) AS units_diff_pct
FROM g LEFT JOIN g b ON b.category = g.category AND b.tactic = 'none'
WHERE g.tactic IS NOT NULL AND g.tactic <> 'none'
ORDER BY g.category, g.tactic
